title: Settings customization and preference matching
summary: Reviews center on adjusting vehicle settings, using assistant or iDrive features to match personal preferences, with some explicitly favorable comments and several fragments that only describe customization without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ease or usefulness of tweaking settings and matching features to personal preferences.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention customization requests, settings changes, or comparisons to iDrive without a clearly stated overall sentiment.

limitations: The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to describe broader patterns beyond these fragments.
Several fragments are undetermined because they describe customization actions or comparisons without clear evaluative sentiment.
